pointsOfInterest.name: Lessu, the Capital City
pointsOfInterest.description: The capital city of Ryloth, where the Twi'lek government and New Republic presence are centered. A mix of traditional Twi'lek architecture and modern galactic structures.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Syndicate Mines
pointsOfInterest.description: Dangerous mining operations controlled by criminal syndicates. The source of Ryll spice extraction and a key location in the Compound 7-Alpha investigation.

pointsOfInterest.name: Abandoned Mine
pointsOfInterest.description: An old, abandoned mining operation that was shut down years ago. Now overrun with dangerous creatures and possibly hiding evidence of the Compound 7-Alpha connection.

pointsOfInterest.name: Tann Province
pointsOfInterest.description: A rural area of Ryloth where refugee settlements and traditional Twi'lek villages are located. The origin point for many Compound 7-Alpha refugees.

pointsOfInterest.name: Lessu Cantina
pointsOfInterest.description: A bustling cantina in the capital city where smugglers, traders, and locals gather. A hub for information and shady deals.

pointsOfInterest.name: Refugee Settlement
pointsOfInterest.description: A temporary settlement for refugees from Compound 7-Alpha and other displaced Twi'leks. A place of hope and struggle.
